يستهلوا (form X)
# يَسْتَهِلُّوا (yastahillū) /jas.ta.hil.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# يُسْتَهَلُّوا (yustahallū) /jus.ta.hal.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
